SYC.note: The document is about a data protection bill and a citizenship bill and states nothing on an access to information law.

facts.fact: Seychelles Nation reports the National Assembly approved the Data Protection Bill 2023 on 5 December 2023, 22 members voting in favour and seven abstaining.
Seychelles Nation reports Vice-President Ahmed Afif's statement that the Data Protection Bill 2023 will be enforced and implemented by the Information Commission.
Seychelles Nation reports the National Assembly approved the Data Protection Bill 2023 on 5 December 2023, and says nothing of it being in force.
